philippines.title: PVL, Spikers’ Turf bring 10th season festivities to Cebu
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Premier Volleyball League and Spikers’ Turf will celebrate their 10th season in Cebu City at  SM Seaside Cebu Arena on October 10. Crowd favorites Creamline and Choco Mucho take on separate foes to kick off the 2026 All-Filipino Conference. Choco Mucho, led by the duo of Sisi Rondina and Eya Laure, battles Capital1 at 1 p.m. 11-time champion Creamline opens its title defense against Akari at 6 p.m. The Spikers’ Turf has yet to announce its game in Cebu. philippines.title: Sandiganbayan orders release of ex-DPWH chief Manuel Bonoan
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Thursday ordered the release of former Public Works and Highways Secretary Manuel “Manny” Bonoan. This came two days after the court granted a motion by state prosecutors to exclude Bonoan from the graft and plunder charges against him, Sen. Jose “Jinggoy” Estrada and three former DPWH district engineers. philippines.title: American jazz singer Cassandra Wilson dies at 70
philippines.description:
WASHINGTON — Grammy Award-winning American jazz singer Cassandra Wilson died on Wednesday in her hometown of Jackson, Mississippi, her manager said. She was 70. “Cassandra Wilson transitioned peacefully at home, surrounded by family, close friends, and her manager,” Robert Torre wrote in a statement, hailing her as a “legendary jazz artist.” The statement did not disclose a cause of death. Wilson’s family and close friends asked for privacy, Torre said. A singer-songwriter and producer, Wilson was celebrated for her rich, expressive contralto voice in a career spanning three decades.
